# 1 Clement Chapter 46 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 46 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_046_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 46

**46:1** Therefore, let us cleave to those who practice peace with godliness, and not to those who desire peace with hypocrisy.

**46:2** For he says in a certain place: "This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me."

**46:3** And again: "They blessed with their mouth, but they cursed in their heart."

**46:4** And again it is said: "They loved him with their mouth, and with their tongue they lied to him; but their heart was not upright before him, and they were not faithful to his covenant."

**46:5** Therefore, let those who have such duplicity of heart be far from us, but let us be found among those who with a pure heart worship him.

**46:6** For it is written: "Who shall ascend the mountain of the LORD? Or who shall stand in his holy place? The one who is innocent of hands and pure in heart, who has not taken up his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbor."

**46:7** "This is the generation of those who seek him, who seek the face of the God of Jacob."

**46:8** And again in another place it says: "Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD."

**46:9** And: "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing. In places of green pasture he has settled me. Beside waters of rest he has nurtured me; he has restored my soul. He has guided me in paths of righteousness for the sake of his name. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff — they have comforted me. You have prepared a table before me in the presence of those who afflict me; you have anointed my head with oil; and your cup intoxicates me exceedingly. And your mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and my dwelling shall be in the house of the LORD for length of days."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
